summary: San Francisco Bay Area, ColdFusion developer, user group manager, speaker at ColdFusion conferences, web development since 1999, strong interest in programming languages (Java, Go, Lua, ColdFusion), expertise in database management (SQL Server, RDBMS), critical of tech industry practices, advocates for open source, engaged in discussions about software development trends, skeptical of venture capital-driven startups, believes in the importance of real business models over acquisition strategies, politically aware with a critical view of corporate influence in politics.
